item.description:
Location: West Africa
Description:

An Assistant Mooring Master is sought for operations on oil tankers in West Africa. The contract offers a rotation of 2 months on followed by 2 months off, with a daily salary of 300-350 USD. Candidates must possess a valid STCW II/2 Certificate of Competency (Chief Mate or Master Mariner) and at least 3 years of experience as Chief Officer, Chief Mate, Master Mariner, or in an equivalent leadership role on large oil tankers or FPSOs. Experience with crude oil loading, offloading, and tandem offloading operations is required, along with advanced English proficiency.



Apply to this job
